tag_test.precondition: Baseline output has no <udw> tags, so the observed original state is off. If baseline is on, record it and restore on instead of blindly leaving off.
tag_test.exact_side_effect: A03CEB52 stores 1 for on or 0 for off to byte current-shell-context+0x14. It affects UDW output formatting for that context, not the global memory/command security gate, printer NVM, radio, job state, or UART baud.
tag_test.output_path: A03CEA70 reads context+0x14. When set, it allocates length+11 bytes, prefixes <udw> (A06074D0), appends </udw> (A06074D8), emits, and frees the temporary allocation. Ordinary shell function-return lines use their normal shell formatting.
tag_test.ludw_equivalence: A02C2D1E (udws) and A02C2D26 (ludw) both call A02C2FB2 in this firmware.
tag_test.probe: shm.msecs handler A03D10BE calls clock read A042ECF0 then shared UDW formatter A02C37BE. A042ECF0 reads the clock pointer at 2085E234 and its pointed counter, shifts value left one. No timer reset/write. This command has already been accepted in root captures.
tag_test.cleanup: Run the restoration toggle even if the intermediate probe produces no payload, then verify a known-good query again.
tag_test.hardware_read: Indirect current-clock counter read; no configuration writes.

hardware_queries.review: Reads 16-bit MMIO BD071C18, BD071C1A, BD066404, BD066408, BD066402, BD073416, BD073412, BD073414. Prints LHCFifo state/control/DMA counters; no MMIO store or start/reset/motion call in handler. A00292A8 temporarily changes interrupt mask and restores it after snapshot.
hardware_queries.limitation: Peripheral read side effects are not formally proved from register documentation; this is the firmware-provided diagnostic snapshot.

hardware_queries.review: Read/print handler, no non-stack stores: RAM counters rooted at 209E3F70 and 209E4074; state helper A01CE980 reads 209E410C. Also reads MMIO BD071C18/1A, BD072002/4, BD073000/2.
hardware_queries.precondition: Pipeline context must exist: live word at 209E3FD4 must point to an initialized object. Handler dereferences it without a null check at A01CDD28/A01CDD32.
hardware_queries.recommendation: Do not guess context validity solely from registration. If current hardware/boot evidence does not establish initialized pipeline context, document deferred coverage instead of risking an assertion solely to fill a coverage count.

uart_reset.run_order: Final native batch command, followed by one previously successful status query and prompt verification.
uart_reset.exact_side_effect: Emits character byte 0xFF through the normal shell printf/output route; returns 0. No reset register, baud/divisor setter, COM reopen, OS restart, or NVM write is called by this handler.
uart_reset.interpretation: Registered description says Reset the text formatting of the uart. Byte 0xFF is the requested output formatting control; downstream driver/terminal rendering is not inferred to equal board reset.
uart_reset.capture_requirement: Preserve raw bytes; a text decoder may display replacement character or nothing for FF.
uart_reset.recovery: No power cycle is expected from this handler. Verify receipt of the return/prompt and next ordinary status query. If that fails, stop the active batch and inspect raw/passive UART output before taking any stronger recovery action.

mem_read_registration_gate.conclusion: udw.mem_read and mem.read are absent from the complete real command registry, so their empty-wrapper response reflects no command execution, not a zero memory value and not suppressed successful output.
mem_read_registration_gate.initializer: A0261634 registers table A05856E4 length3 at A026163A. A026163E calls A00089DE; nonzero branches at A0261644 directly to return A026164E. Only zero registers table A0585708 length7 via A026164A.
mem_read_registration_gate.handler_if_registered: A02613A4 itself does not check debug gate. It parses two decimal arguments, directly reads requested width, then formats %12u%c with semicolon. This handler must never be invoked with missing arguments because conversion count is ignored.
mem_read_registration_gate.unknown_dispatch: A02C2D2E missing-name path at A02C2F12 consumes through semicolon and returns 0. Top-level udws context wrapper can also return 0, therefore that return code alone does not establish existence or execution.
mem_read_registration_gate.mem_dram_size: A02614C8 is BX LR, explaining no payload for registered mem.dram_size independently of the registration gate.
mem_read_registration_gate.action: No memory walks through unavailable commands, no RAM/ROM patch, no NVM/access-gate changes, no func_call bypass.

coverage_of_21_native_functions.note: Each registered native function has an appropriate test or a concrete reason for conditional deferral; valid-argument destructive paths are not necessary for command reference coverage.
